analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Reclaiming the rising 21-day EMA after constructing a double-bottom base above its 50-day and 200-day moving averages. Momentum is constructive with RSI at 69 and volume supporting pivot resistance at 528.03, satisfying Minervini Trend Template criteria.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Q2 FY27 delivered robust margin expansion to 16.6% as EBITDA rose 63% and PAT surged 83% to ₹83 crore on ₹829 crore revenue. While Q1 was soft (-7.1%), backward integration and specialty chemical capex at Sayakha drive operating leverage with manageable debt.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Failure below the 487.43 stop violates the double-bottom pivot and 50-day SMA, demanding an immediate cut to preserve capital.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Displays classic Stage 2 structure trading well above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. MACD is positive and RSI at 69 reflects strong relative strength without extension. The double-bottom neckline at 1048.30 presents a high-probability pivot.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals fueled by Xanthine derivative volume expansion and rapid CDMO traction. Operational revenue surged 46.8% YoY to ₹612.6 crore while EBITDA margins expanded 441 bps to 22.17%. ROCE remains robust above 18% with modest debt.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A break below 961.36 invalidates the double-bottom support; exit swiftly per Minervini risk parameters if CDMO cash conversion lags.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Maintains a firm Stage 2 uptrend above its key moving averages. The double bottom pattern near 427.88 shows drying supply and bullish MACD confirmation, with RSI at 60 providing ample runway before overbought conditions.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Superb institutional sponsorship and compounding. Consolidated revenue grew 31% YoY to ₹16,545 crore with lending AUM up 32% to ₹2.34 lakh crore. Solid 38% PAT growth and expanding NBFC RoA (2.45%) confirm quality fundamentals with zero promoter pledge.
ABCAPITAL.risk: A close beneath the 406.56 swing low violates trend structure and requires immediate exit to contain portfolio drawdown.

ABDL.technical: Consolidating above the 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA in a double-bottom formation with 1.35x volume expansion. However, relative strength lags sector frontrunners, signaling secondary leadership.
ABDL.fundamental: Q2 FY27 revenue rose just 6.8% YoY to ₹2,085 crore with PAT up 9.7% to ₹69 crore, failing O'Neil's 25% EPS and 15% revenue thresholds. Thin operating margins (6.7%) and legacy leverage weigh on return ratios despite record volume gains.
ABDL.risk: Breaching 798.50 breaks the lower base boundary; O'Neil rules dictate immediate loss cutting given sub-par earnings velocity.

ABSLLIQUID.technical: An overnight cash-management ETF tracking TREPS repo rates. Apparent technical pivots reflect fractional tick-level noise rather than institutional accumulation. Displays zero trend template validity for equity momentum trading.
ABSLLIQUID.fundamental: ABSLLIQUID is a debt ETF allocating 95–100% of net assets to overnight money market instruments (TREPS). Equity metrics like EPS growth, operating margins, ROE/ROCE, and promoter holding are wholly inapplicable.
ABSLLIQUID.risk: Principal risk is virtually absent, but holding it incurs complete opportunity cost against active equity leadership setups.

ACE.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout to all-time highs on massive volume (9.98x 20-day average), clearing a 20-day resistance pivot at 1269.27. Strong relative strength and alignment above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 confirm aggressive institutional accumulation.
ACE.fundamental: Market leader holding 63% mobile crane and 60% tower crane share. Standalone revenue rose 18.9% YoY to ₹885 crore with normalized EBITDA up 30.2% (19.3% margin). Low leverage, net-cash balance sheet, and ~28% ROCE provide premier CANSLIM pedigree.
ACE.risk: A reversal below 1179.17 invalidates the high-volume pivot breakout; cut losses ruthlessly to protect trading capital.
